author: reek
body: An `opening` that RETURNS a moded Real, which is a different walk from `show` and was broken for as long as the modes existed.

author: reek
body: `emit-opening-result-print` matched `RealTy` alone and its tail is `otherwise -> st`, which emits nothing at all. So a program whose entry point returned `Real trapping` printed NO OUTPUT -- not a wrong number, no line. `real-mode-show` cannot see it: that test calls `show` inside an act block, which is `emit-show-builtin`, a walk that asks `is-real-type` and was always right.

author: reek
body: The distinction matters for the pin: a test that prints a moded Real is not a test that RETURNS one, and only the second reaches this emitter.
